name: Card
summary: A surface that groups related content — cover, title, body and footer actions — in default/small size, bordered or flat, with a hover lift, an opt-in keyboard-reachable clickable mode, equal-height stretch in a grid and a loading skeleton.
highlights: Cover, title, body and footer actions
Default or small, bordered or flat, hover lift, loading skeleton
Opt-in clickable card reachable by keyboard, with a disabled state; equal heights in a grid
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-card> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Card is a family, not a single box: slot="cover" adds a full-bleed image, `card-title` renders the header as plain text (slot="title" takes a rich title instead and wins over the attribute) with slot="extra" for a right-aligned action, the default slot is the body, slot="actions" is a ruled-off footer row. `size` (default · small) tunes the padding, `bordered="false"` drops the outline, `hoverable` lifts the card on hover, `interactive` makes the whole card one keyboard-reachable button (role="button", tabindex="0", Enter and Space fire click, the DS focus ring on keyboard focus; add `disabled` and it becomes inert: aria-disabled, out of the tab order, no click), `stretch` fills the grid or flex cell so cards in a row share one height, and `loading` swaps the body for a shimmer skeleton. Shadow-DOM CSS themed only by --aha-* tokens — zero drift, the same element in every framework.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Cover
spec.value: full-bleed media above the header, no inset; hidden when the slot is empty

spec.label: Header
spec.value: padding 16/20 · 16/24 SemiBold #1A1A1A · divider #F1F1F1 · extra action right-aligned

spec.label: Actions
spec.value: footer row, 12/20 padding, 8 gap, top divider #F1F1F1; hidden when empty

spec.label: Hover (hoverable)
spec.value: border #E70E68 + shadow, motion-mid ease-out on a persistent node

spec.label: Title slot
spec.value: slot="title" renders rich content in the header (16/24 SemiBold #1A1A1A); wins over card-title, which is always plain text

spec.label: Interactive
spec.value: role=button + tabindex=0 on the host (author values kept); Enter on keydown, Space on keyup fire click, not while loading; hover as hoverable; disabled: see the row below; keyboard focus ring 2px #E70E68 at 2px offset, radius 12 (leave 4px of room: an overflow:hidden parent clips it)

spec.label: Disabled (interactive)
spec.value: aria-disabled=true and tabindex=-1 added (author aria-disabled kept, author tabindex restored on enable); no click from mouse, Enter, Space, click() or a dispatched click; no hover lift; fill #F1F1F1, border #EBEBEB, header and body text #B5B5B5 (the card-select disabled tokens), cursor not-allowed. Ignored without interactive

spec.label: Stretch
spec.value: the card fills the height its grid or flex cell stretches the host to; body grows so the actions row sits at the bottom

spec.label: Loading
spec.value: body → shimmer skeleton bars (aria-busy), motion-slow sweep

props.name: card-title
props.desc: Renders the header row as plain text (never markup); omit for a bare body

props.name: bordered
props.desc: Set bordered="false" for a flat, outline-less surface

props.name: hoverable
props.desc: Lift the card (border + shadow) on hover

props.name: interactive
props.desc: The whole card is one button: role="button" and tabindex="0" (unless set), Enter and Space fire the native click event (not while loading), hover lift and the DS focus ring. Listen for click; keep other controls (extra, actions) out of an interactive card, since its whole content is the button's name

props.name: disabled
props.desc: With interactive: the card is inert. aria-disabled="true", tabindex="-1" (out of the tab order), no click from the mouse, Enter, Space, click() or a dispatched click, no hover lift, and the DS disabled look. Removing it restores the tab stop. Ignored on a card without interactive; also readable and settable as the disabled property

props.name: stretch
props.desc: Fill the height of its grid or flex cell so cards in a row share one height; the body grows and the actions row sits at the bottom. The parent must stretch its items (the grid and flex default)

props.name: loading
props.desc: Swap the body for a shimmer skeleton while content loads

props.name: title
props.desc: Rich header title (text with an icon, tag or link); shows the header and wins over card-title

props.name: extra
props.desc: Right-aligned header action (a link or button)

whenToUse.when: grouping related content into a titled surface on a dashboard or settings page
many uniform rows of the same shape
read-only label/value pairs about one entity

opinion.note: Titles are sentence case and name the group — 'Live results', not 'LIVE RESULTS'. Keep one idea per card; reach for interactive when the whole card is clickable (it adds the keyboard path hoverable lacks) and keep other controls out of it; use stretch for a grid of cards with uneven content. Use a cover for a media-led card, footer actions for card-level operations, and loading while the body fetches.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Card component-set taxonomy (Card + Card_Image_Wrapper for the cover, Card_Meta_Wrapper for the title/body meta, plus size/bordered/hoverable states matching antd Card). DS V3's measured set has no Card cell, so px/rgb are derived from the token layer (radius-lg, border, border-hover, split, bg-container, text-default/secondary, ink-a10) + antd Card conventions (16/24 header + 20 body default; 8/12 header + 12 body small). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.
